basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior AI Engineer | Production Agents, RAG & MCP | LangChain / LangGraph / CrewAI | Open Source
basics.summary: Senior AI engineer shipping production agents that real users depend on. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps: multi-agent workflows on Python with LangChain, LangGraph and Google ADK; tools over MCP servers I authored; RAG grounded by a temporal knowledge graph (Graphiti/Neo4j); LangSmith tracing and cost-per-request instrumentation. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly. Prior LLM shipping at Beekeeper (LangChain, CrewAI, $337K/yr saved on translation). Founded 3 AI products solo through Anand Creations. Open source: Robogen (AI research at EPFL, featured on AWS blog) and a Terraform module on the Registry with ~4,600 users. Fully remote-native since Obermatt in 2018.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Architected and deployed a production multi-agent system on Python with LangChain, LangGraph, and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI. Tools exposed over MCP servers I authored, agent state streamed over AG-UI. High-performance, fault-tolerant AI service with fallback/retry and on-call. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly.
Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware store grounding all RAG retrieval.
Own the observability and evaluation layer: LangSmith tracing on every run, golden suites, judge rubrics, safety cases, cost-per-request instrumentation. No agent ships without evals.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI + LangChain). 12K+ assets translated; product team ships in new languages without a gatekeeper.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist and a GenAI demo generator using LangChain + CrewAI. LLM-powered features shipped end to end (prompts, orchestration, UI, evals). Improved demo speed and close rates.
Designed a distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). High-performance backend for 10M+ users.
Ran observability and global on-call across K8s + AWS (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io, Langfuse). Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Shipped full stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform infra) from empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries. Backend built for fault tolerance from day one.
Direct engagement with enterprise partners (Unilever) and CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.position: AI Research Engineer & Open Source Maintainer
highlights: Built and open-sourced Robogen, a platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Data manipulation and scientific computing (Pandas, NumPy) for large-scale AWS parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research.

_jobApplication.notes: STRONG FIT. Nice-to-haves: LangSmith (LumApps direct), OSS (Terraform + Robogen), Pandas/NumPy (EPFL research), CrewAI + LangGraph (Beekeeper + LumApps).
